title: Kwaidan: Stories and Studies of Strange Things
sourceTitle: Kwaidan: Stories and Studies of Strange Things
author: Lafcadio Hearn
description: "Kwaidan: Stories and Studies of Strange Things" by Lafcadio Hearn is a collection published in 1904.
longDescription: This haunting volume gathers Japanese ghost stories translated from old texts, alongside tales told directly to Hearn and personal recollections. From vengeful spirits to supernatural encounters, these eerie narratives explore the mysterious world of Japanese folklore.

authorInfo.bio: Patrick Lafcadio Hearn was a Greek and Irish writer, translator, and teacher whose work played a significant role in the introduction of the culture and literature of Japan to the mainstream Western world.
